## Description {#details}

<p>A wrapper around a string literal that serves as a proxy for constructing global tables of StringRefs with the length computed at compile time.</p>


<p>In order to avoid the invocation of a global constructor, <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/stringliteral">StringLiteral</a> should <em>only</em> be used in a constexpr context, as such:</p>


<p>constexpr <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/stringliteral">StringLiteral</a> S("test");</p>


<p>Definition at line 853 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/adt/stringref-h">StringRef.h</a>.</p>
